plain_language.what_did_we_find: Provisional: the two proposed expression families have direct typing arguments, and the retained checker binaries match their source identities. Five pure-producer tests pass using synthetic small cases only. No selected workload or observer result exists yet.
plain_language.is_it_interesting: Potentially. The families exercise different declaration-checking paths and can provide a finite resource baseline, but small inputs may remain dominated by startup. No resource behavior has been measured.
plain_language.does_it_require_more_work: Yes. Complete independent validity/identity auditing and measurement-control tests, resolve the protocol details below, and freeze reviewed committed inputs before construction or launch.

findings.source_identity: Independently verified arena 37f7525b732808a49b746dc6999d53c3717db124, Nanoda 6ae1f0cd962f081f6c423454c5da729d841236a7, producer cacf989bd75f608700820f6afc595f32e7a99a4d and official importer f297dfe2a8557e8674fe892bb49dffe4bfadc0e9 revisions. findings.checking_path: Official normal invocation parses then replays safe definitions through addDeclCore; optional parse-only is not selected. Nanoda main calls check_all_declars; serial config avoids prior four-thread setting. Output count alone does not exclude Lean replay skipping unsafe/partial definitions; independent audit must prove exact safe total one-definition metadata.
findings.typing: For n >= 1, Pi domains and terminal Sort 0 each have type Sort 1; repeated imax 1 1 gives Sort 1. In the let chain, Sort 0 inhabits the first Sort 1 annotation, each later value references the previous Sort 1 variable, and final body references the last; the result has type Sort 1 and normal form Sort 0. No constants or axioms are needed.
findings.sizes_and_metrics: Prespecified n=16,32,64,128,256,512 is a finite static span, not a detected cliff. Expanded value nodes are 2 n+1(Pi) and 3 n+1(let); binderdepth n and root-counted depthn+1. DAG node count and serialized bytes require actual independent export audit.
findings.producer: Pure renderer matches exact draft grammar and makes no term at import. Test suite constructs only n=2 source/metric fixtures and disjoint n=3 name strings; selected_slots produces schedule metadata only. Graph metric routine is not a validity oracle and cannot replace the independent auditor.
findings.baseline: Six zero-declaration baseline runs per profile with the same normal invocation are a matched startup/empty-input task. They neither isolate size-dependent import time nor justify subtracting RSS peaks. All 12 baseline runs must reconcile separately from 24 science dispositions.

Define sample-gap endpoints, zero-sample healthy fast exit, monitored-over-limit versus wait4-over-ceiling after exit, and precisely which dispositions stop larger family sizes.
Define elapsed timing endpoint and pipe-drain/cleanup accounting; avoid any Popen poll/wait/communicate reaping race with wait4.
Freeze exact build-workspace templates, invocation, environment and limits before constructing selected sources.
findings.remaining: No protocol-freeze, producer/controller construction, auditor, supervisor or launch PASS is issued here. Runtime identities, independent audit/negative tests, committed scientific/execution manifests, exact generated input audit and actual-host process checks remain gates.
